# Reservista by Megon

> Reservista is a hotel management software (PMS) and point-of-sale (POS)
> platform built specifically for hotels, resorts, homestays, restaurants,
> bars and cafes in Assam and Northeast India. Made by Megon Technologies
> India Pvt. Ltd., a Guwahati-based travel technology company. DPIIT-recognised
> startup (DIPP223285), Startup Assam registered (MASI2025/804), supported by
> NRL Ideation.

## What Reservista does

Reservista replaces registers, spreadsheets and disconnected systems with one
simple, mobile-first dashboard. Hoteliers in Northeast India use it to manage
bookings, billing, room status, guest profiles and daily reports — all from
a phone, tablet or laptop, even on slow internet.

## Products

- [Hotel Management Software (PMS)](https://reservista.cloud/hotel-management-software-assam): Bookings, check-ins, room management, guest profiles, GST invoicing, OTA channel sync (Booking.com, MMT, Agoda), reports.
- [Hotel POS & Billing Software](https://reservista.cloud/hotel-pos-software-assam): Restaurant, bar and cafe billing, KOT, room-charge posting, multi-outlet support, GST-ready invoices.
- GuestKYC (coming soon): Fast and compliant guest ID verification.
- MyAlohi (coming soon): Direct-booking site and channel-management tools.

## Frequently asked

**What is Reservista?**
A hotel management (PMS) and point-of-sale (POS) software built for hotels,
resorts, restaurants, bars and cafes in Assam and Northeast India.

**Who is it for?**
Small and mid-sized hotels, resorts, homestays and standalone food &
beverage outlets — particularly properties in Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal
Pradesh, Nagaland, Mizoram, Manipur, Tripura and Sikkim.

**Where is the company based?**
Guwahati, Assam, India. Megon Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. is a registered
private limited company; office at 59 Upper Chachal, VIP Road, Six Mile,
Guwahati – 781022.

**Does it work on slow internet?**
Yes. Reservista is mobile-first and designed to work reliably on 3G/4G
networks across Northeast India.

**Is support available locally?**
Yes. Local support is available in Assamese, Hindi and English via WhatsApp,
phone and email — Mon–Sat, 9 AM – 7 PM IST.

**How do I try it?**
Book a free demo at https://reservista.cloud/demo or message +91-98640-83397
on WhatsApp.
